see_for_yourself.expected: The picked stretch is filled, the line under the bar reads 7–10 PM and then 6:30–9 PM, and the dropdowns follow.
steps: Open rehearse.dalan.dev as an organizer and start a new request from your group.
On the bar, tap 7 PM and then 10 PM.
Drag from 6:30 PM to 9 PM instead.
see_for_yourself.title: Pick a time on your phone

see_for_yourself.expected: Every time reads with AM or PM; no 19:00-style times remain.
steps: Open My availability, a request, the group's Schedule and the home page.
see_for_yourself.title: Read times across the app

what_just_landed.detail: Every time the app shows reads like 7–10 PM or 6:30–9 PM; midnight reads 12 AM. Stored times, the calendar feed and Google Calendar events are unchanged.
what_just_landed.title: 12-hour times everywhere

what_just_landed.detail: A bar from 9 AM to midnight replaces the tall time grid on My availability, a new request and Propose a different time: tap a start and an end, or drag across, in half-hour steps. From and Until dropdowns under it work by keyboard and without JavaScript.
what_just_landed.title: An hour bar for picking times
